# The bill-side mirror of a sale: a 100 USD payable booked at 1.40 settled with
# USD cash that cost 1.35. No CAD moves, yet 5.00 CAD is realized — the two
# monetary items were acquired at different rates — and the transaction only
# balances with that difference booked.
2026-03-01 * "Pay US vendor with USD cash"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.40"
		value: "140.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{bill_basis}"
	Assets:Bank:USD -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "-135.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{cash_basis}"
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
